C159.notes: SER NA-EC-001. Reverse Golden Hind under sail · EAST CARIBBEAN STATES · 10 flanking masts · TEN CENTS · user shorthand 2004 east Caribbean + photo. Shared currency of the OECS island states — one CuNi ship buying ferry change, market odd-cents, and tourist soda across Antigua, Dominica, Grenada, St Lucia, St Vincent, and kin. Drake’s flagship still sailing the small change. East Caribbean States flips now 1.
C159.story: A 2004 10 cents from East Caribbean States. The obverse shows Elizabeth II; the reverse shows Golden Hind under sail; EAST CARIBBEAN STATES, 10 flanking masts, TEN CENTS. Struck in cupronickel.
